## Heures enseignées

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

try:
    df = pd.read_csv("../data/enseignements.csv")
    agg = df.groupby(["annee_universitaire", "module"])["heures"].sum().reset_index()
    fig = px.bar(
        agg, x="annee_universitaire", y="heures", color="module",
        labels={"heures": "Heures", "annee_universitaire": "Année universitaire"},
        color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Set2,
    )
    fig.update_layout(template="plotly_white", height=420, barmode="stack",
                       margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
    fig.show()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Données à compléter ({e})")
```

## Encadrements

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

try:
    df = pd.read_csv("../data/encadrements.csv")
    agg = df.groupby(["annee", "type"]).size().reset_index(name="count")
    fig = px.line(
        agg, x="annee", y="count", color="type", markers=True,
        labels={"count": "Nombre d'encadrements", "annee": "Année"},
        color_discrete_sequence=["#C8102E", "#4A4A4A", "#0277BD"],
    )
    fig.update_layout(template="plotly_white", height=380,
                       margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
    fig.show()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Données à compléter ({e})")
```

## Certifications obtenues

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

try:
    df = pd.read_csv("../data/certifications.csv")
    df["annee"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"]).dt.year
    agg = df.groupby("annee").size().reset_index(name="count")
    fig = px.bar(
        agg, x="annee", y="count",
        labels={"count": "Certifications obtenues", "annee": "Année"},
        color_discrete_sequence=["#C8102E"],
    )
    fig.update_layout(template="plotly_white", height=320,
                       margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
    fig.show()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Données à compléter ({e})")
```

## Timeline globale

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

try:
    enseignements = pd.read_csv("../data/enseignements.csv")
    enseignements["categorie"] = "Enseignement"
    enseignements["intitule"] = enseignements["module"]

    encadrements = pd.read_csv("../data/encadrements.csv")
    encadrements["categorie"] = "Encadrement"
    encadrements["annee_universitaire"] = encadrements["annee"]

    df = pd.concat([
        enseignements[["annee_universitaire", "categorie", "intitule"]],
        encadrements[["annee_universitaire", "categorie"]].assign(
            intitule=encadrements["sujet"] if "sujet" in encadrements else "Encadrement"
        ),
    ])
    agg = df.groupby(["annee_universitaire", "categorie"]).size().reset_index(name="count")
    fig = px.area(
        agg, x="annee_universitaire", y="count", color="categorie",
        labels={"count": "Volume d'activité", "annee_universitaire": "Année"},
        color_discrete_sequence=["#C8102E", "#4A4A4A", "#0277BD", "#2E7D32"],
    )
    fig.update_layout(template="plotly_white", height=380,
                       margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
    fig.show()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Timeline à compléter ({e})")
```
